dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Point at Paimon with your right hand, and pat your own head with your left hand.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, Bongo-Head and Paimon remember this gesture! Bongo-Head's always happy to let Paimon pat its head.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mm-hmm! Kindlejoy's learned not to jump onto Paimon's head too! Now that's what we call progress!
